description: Day 5 of the demo: the second call on the same deal. Ramesh says the total was 25,000 (his offer on call 1; both agreed 22,000): Gawah says what the record holds and offers the recording, Sunita asks to hear it, and Ramesh takes it back. Then both agree a change by voice: the balcony wall, 2,000 extra, 24,000 in all, which holds only once both say haan to Gawah. Fields as in story_call_1.json.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Main Sunita. Main bhi sehmat hoon.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Madam, aadha kaam ho gaya. Total pachees hazaar tay hua tha na?

then.gawah: says the record holds 22,000, not 25,000: Ramesh said it on call 1 and Sunita agreed; and asks if they want to hear that recording
plays the recording of call 1 where 22,000 was agreed

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan ji, baees hi. Galti ho gayi.

then.gawah: may stay quiet: the record stands at 22,000

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Ek kaam aur hai. Balcony ki deewar bhi paint kar dijiye.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ho jayega madam. Uske do hazaar extra lagenge.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, do hazaar extra. Total chaubees hazaar.

then.gawah: says the change, 22,000 to 24,000 (record mein 22,000; call par 24,000), and asks both to say haan

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan ji, mujhe bhi manzoor hai.

then.gawah: says the change holds: the total is now 24,000
